title: The Salty Dog Vacation Rental
meta_description: The Salty Dog is a 4.00 bedroom, 3.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Tucked away in WaterColor's peaceful Forest District, The Salty Dog offers the perfect blend of coastal comfort, thoughtful amenities, and relaxed luxury. From leisurely bike rides to Camp WaterColor to evenings spent on the porch after a day at the beach, every detail has been designed for an unforgettable 30A getaway. Looking ahead to Spring 2027, this exceptional retreat is anticipated to debut a brand-new private swimming pool, creating an even more inviting outdoor experience for future guests. (Completion is anticipated for Spring 2027 and is subject to construction timelines.)Property Highlights Private Pool – Coming March 2027 Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools with Up to 8 Passes Included 6-Passenger Street-Legal Electric Cart Included in Rental 4 Adult Bikes Included in Rental Pet-Friendly (Additional Fee Applies) Fenced-In Backyard Propane Grill Parking for 2 Vehicles Spacious Porches Hardwood Floors Throughout Gas Range 2-Minute Bike Ride to Camp WaterColor 5-Minute Electric Cart Ride to WaterColor Beach Access 4-Minute Electric Cart Ride to Seaside Experience the Home Thoughtfully designed for families, friends, and even four-legged companions, The Salty Dog offers a relaxed WaterColor retreat where comfort, convenience, and coastal charm come together. Located in the peaceful Forest District, this inviting home places you just minutes from Camp WaterColor, the Beach Club, and the shops and restaurants of Seaside while providing a quiet place to unwind at the end of each day. The open-concept living area creates a welcoming gathering space, with comfortable seating and abundant natural light that make it just as enjoyable for a quiet morning as it is for family movie nights after a day at the beach.The well-appointed kitchen features premium appliances, generous workspace, and everything needed to prepare anything from a quick breakfast before heading out to a leisurely dinner shared around the table. The adjacent dining area keeps everyone connected, whether you're enjoying takeout from Seaside or a home-cooked meal. Designed with outdoor living in mind, the spacious covered porches and fenced backyard invite guests to slow down and enjoy the coastal lifestyle. Sip your morning coffee outdoors, fire up the grill after a day on 30A, or simply relax while children and pets enjoy the private yard. Looking ahead, this exceptional retreat is anticipated to debut a brand-new private swimming pool in Spring 2027, creating an even more inviting outdoor experience for future stays. Completion is anticipated for Spring 2027 and is subject to construction timelines. Exploring WaterColor couldn't be easier with the included 6-passenger street-legal electric cart and four adult bikes, making it simple to spend the day at Camp WaterColor, relax at the Beach Club, or venture into nearby Seaside for shopping, dining, and entertainment. Whether you're planning a week at the beach, a multigenerational family vacation, or a getaway with friends, The Salty Dog combines thoughtful amenities, an exceptional location, and the relaxed elegance that make every 30A vacation unforgettable.Why Guests Love The Salty Dog Peaceful Forest District location Fenced backyard for children and pets Downstairs guest suite ideal for grandparents 6-passenger electric cart included Minutes to Camp WaterColor, the Beach Club, and Seaside Private pool anticipated Spring 2027 Sleeping Arrangements First Floor: Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Second Floor: Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Soaking Tub and Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Beds (Sleeps 2), Shared Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combination Guest Bedroom: Twin Bunk Bed (Sleeps 2), Shared Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combination Life in WaterColor Life at The Salty Dog is all about experiencing the best of WaterColor. Bike to Camp WaterColor for lazy river fun, spend afternoons at the Beach Club overlooking the Gulf, explore the shops and restaurants of Seaside, then return home to the quiet charm of the Forest District. It's the perfect balance of convenience, relaxation, and coastal adventure.
